senses.gloss: m., constr. <cite ref="E00041"><he>הֲבֵל</he></cite> or <cite ref="E00041"><he>הֲבַל</he></cite> (b. h.)

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 88b:8">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>בה׳ שבפיהם</he> with the (fiery) breath of their mouths.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119b:10">Ib. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ תינוקות וכ׳</he> the breath of school children.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ שאין בו חטא</he> a sinless breath (of children).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:4:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ה׳ המרחץ וכ׳</he> the vapor of the bath room is injurious to the teeth.

<cite ref="Yevamot 80b:8">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>אין בשרו מעלה ה׳</he> his body (after bathing) does not steam. Pesik. Baḥod. p. 154ᵃ; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:8">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 62:10">Ps. LXII, 10</cite>) <he>עד שהן עשויין ה׳ בתוך וכ׳</he> while they are yet a gas (in the first embryonic stage) …, they are predestined for marital union.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:2:2">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הה׳ כובש</he> the heat (of the fresh bread placed on top of an open wine casket) keeps the evaporations of the wine down.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 50b:5">B. Kam. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>להַבְלוֹ</he> for injuries suffered through the bad air of the pit (into which the animal fell), opp. to <he>לחבטו</he> injuries arising from knocking against the ground.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:2:1">Koh. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>ה׳ של תנור</he> the hot air of the stove; <he>ה׳ של עליונה</he> the vapor of the topmost pot; Yalk. ib. 966 <he>ה׳ שביעית</he>; a. e.—
B. Bath. 16ᵇ תנחומין של ה׳ vain consolations. Koh. R. l. c.; Yalk. l. c. (ref. to Ps. CXLIV, 4) לאיזו ה׳ to what kind of hebel (breath) man is like; a. fr.—Pl. הֲבָלִים.
Ib. שבעה ה׳ וכ׳ the seven times that Solomon used the word hebel. Pesik. Baḥod. l. c.; Lev. R. l. c. כל ה׳ וכזבים וכ׳ all the vain things and falsehoods which the Israelites commit.
